BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The stored data is reachable through the user's browser storage or a compromised data store.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker first needs access to the storage, such as the end-user machine or a database copy.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No application account is needed once the storage is reachable.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No user action is needed to read the stored data.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Only data held by the vulnerable application is exposed.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Passwords, tokens or personal data are disclosed in clear text.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Reading the data does not change it.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_VECTOR
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Same as the base metric: the stored data is reachable through the user's browser storage or a compromised data store.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Same as the base metric: the attacker first needs access to the storage, such as the end-user machine or a database copy.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_USER_INTERACTION

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_SCOPE
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Same as the base metric: only data held by the vulnerable application is exposed.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_CONFIDENTIALITY

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_INTEGRITY

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_AVAILABILITY

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: CONFIDENTIALITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Protecting application data and secrets is critical.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: INTEGRITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Data integrity matters but is not critical.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: AVAILABILITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Availability is not the primary concern.
